{{DISPLAYTITLE:''Final Fantasy Tactics Advance'' reaction abilities}}
[[File:FFTA Reaction Ability Icon.png|right]]
'''Reaction abilities''' {{J|リアクションアビリティ|Riakushon Abiriti}} in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' are learned via [[Ability Points]] (AP). Each character can equip one reaction ability. Reaction abilities activate when their trigger condition is met. The reaction abilities vary, ranging from retaliating actions to bestowing positive status.
